tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Farm access rules tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks that each kind of request is allowed or refused according to a person's role and the flocks they are assigned to.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Flock assignment shortcut tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks the sample-data shortcut that assigns a worker to a flock without the usual extra confirmation, and that it is tightly limited.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Access setup order tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks that the parts that look up who can reach which flock are wired in correctly when the server starts.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Flock access lookup tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks the lookup that says which flocks a person may see, which the sale confirmation and flock checks rely on.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Seeded assignment all-or-nothing tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks that when saving the record of a first flock assignment fails, the assignment itself is not left half saved.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Access seeding wiring tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks that the startup step that sets up access depends only on what it is allowed to.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Access seeding author tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks that records written while setting up access name the right person or system as the author.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Access seeding failure tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks what happens when setting up access fails because the owner cannot be read or the details are invalid.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Access seeding lookup tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks the lookups the access setup step uses to find owners, flocks and existing assignments.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Farm ownership stamp tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks that every record tied to a farm carries a version stamp so two people saving at once cannot overwrite each other.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Farm separation safety tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks that a record tied to a farm in an unexpected way is refused rather than quietly skipping the checks that keep farms apart.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Farm account lifecycle tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks the commands that manage a farm account from creation onward, including their results and refusals.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Sign-in lockout tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks that repeated wrong passwords lock an account, even against the right password, that a success resets the count, and that locks are per account.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Maximum discount change tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks the database change that adds a per-farm maximum discount, using a throwaway database.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: New farm setup tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks that creating a new farm account sets up its first owner and starting data, and that failures leave nothing behind.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Farm rename tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks that renaming a farm account works and refuses names that clash or are invalid.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Per-farm sign-in change tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks the database change that lets the same email belong to different farms while staying unique within one.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Per-farm user check order tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks that the rule keeping emails unique within a farm is registered in the right order.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Per-farm user check tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks that emails must be unique within a farm, both when users are created and when they are updated.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Farm web-name change tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks the database change that gives each existing farm a short web name.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Farm suspension race tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks that two people suspending or reactivating the same farm at once cannot both succeed.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.name: Farm suspension tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Acc.description: Checks suspending and reactivating a farm account, including who is blocked while it is suspended.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Adm.name: Admin-only access tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Adm.description: Checks that admin-only actions are refused to everyone who is not an admin.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Adm.name: Locked-out admin recovery tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Adm.description: Checks the emergency way to reset an admin's password, using its own separate database.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/All.name: Allowed web address tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/All.description: Checks that a live server refuses to start when the list of allowed web addresses is left open.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Amb.name: Sign-in with stray pass tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Amb.description: Checks that signing in behaves the same whether or not the caller also sends an existing sign-in pass.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/App.name: Database tooling safety tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/App.description: Checks that database tooling refuses to guess a default connection and holds live targets to the same secure-connection rule as the server.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/App.name: User uniqueness setup tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/App.description: Quickly checks that the stored shape of users enforces email uniqueness per farm.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Ato.name: Duplicate request protection tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Ato.description: Checks that repeating the same request returns the first answer without redoing the work, and that waiting on a competing request gives up in bounded time.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Aud.name: Audit trail author tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Aud.description: Checks that the activity log refuses to record a change when it cannot tell who made it.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Aud.name: Audit trail connected app tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Aud.description: Checks that the activity log names the connected app someone used, alongside the person.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Aud.name: Who created or changed it tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Aud.description: Checks that who first created a record and who last changed it are worked out correctly from the activity log.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Aud.name: Audit trail tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Aud.description: Checks that changes are logged in the same step as the change, name the signed-in person, and can be viewed only by admins.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Aut.name: Oversized sign-in tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Aut.description: Checks that very large sign-in details are rejected early, before any password work, while normal ones get the usual refusal.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Aut.name: Sign-in cookie tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Aut.description: Checks that the long-lived sign-in pass is only delivered as a protected browser cookie, and marked secure over HTTPS.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Aut.name: Sign-in rate limit logging tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Aut.description: Checks that too many sign-in or refresh attempts are logged as a distinct warning, while other blocked requests are not.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Aut.name: Sign-in session tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Aut.description: Checks the sign-in and sign-out behaviours the server decides on its own, such as staying signed in.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Bas.name: Starting currency tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Bas.description: Checks that a newly created farm can still change its currency, since nothing yet depends on it.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Bas.name: Starting data change tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Bas.description: Checks the database changes that load the built-in lists, such as grades and categories, into a fresh database.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Bir.name: Bird count tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Bir.description: Checks bird deaths, culls and adjustments, the running bird count, and which flock states allow changes.
